summary: R-005 refitted each of the six fittable-lane children of logs/two_lane_search and its seed-bank parent identically (fit seed 2611, same demos, deterministic_mse, budget 1000, checkpoints {0,500,1000} probe-selected on development 40-49) and scored all on 50 fresh cases (pool seed 2610). Child minus parent, averaged over pairs per placement: -0.020, t95 [-0.046, +0.006]; the predicted +0.05 is refuted, and the direction is inconclusive. Per pair: the geometry-scope mutation of simple_damped_push gained +0.14 (7/0/43), cand0 lost -0.16, two children tied their parents on every case. All 11 fits selected step 1000. The two-lane winner beats the zero-success gpt-6.1-sol baseline by +0.98 [+0.94, +1.02] (R-001), but it ties its own fitted parent, so that gain is the seed bank plus rollout-selected fitting, not the LLM mutation.
next_step: Treat seed bank + rollout-selected fitting as the operative method; test the LLM mutation step only where it showed a signal (geometry scope), or redirect LLM budget to repair with richer evidence.
